items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That's what one of the boys come out there with Duke... [INTERVIEWEE] But he said he imitated.

ctx.x: So that's what one of the musicians... Too much repetition. Yeah, that's what one of the boys come out there with Duke, you see. Yeah, yeah. He told me, I said, how come Alan ain't got on the top like Lewis? He said, well, he imitated Lewis. Yeah, yeah. He said he should have a style of his own. Then he said he played nice trumpet, playing the trumpet. Oh, yeah.
But he said he imitated. Too much.
